title: 2110 Prairie's loggia on colonnettes, its landing parapet and its stone stack
items: 2110 Prairie's five-arched loggia now stands on six round colonnettes with leafed capitals, the arches springing from them as both photographs of the house show; its slates run on to the gable instead of hipping short of it, the south chimney is laid in the front's pale stone, and the landing carries on across the foot of the bow behind a solid stone parapet level with the parlour windows' sills.
